title: Link
description: Fiori link: Default, Subtle and Emphasized designs, wrapping, Enter/Space activation.

usage.summary: Navigate through meaningful text to a page, anchor or external URL.
useWhen: Let users open another page, jump to an anchor or follow an external URL.
Describe the destination or outcome in the link text instead of using Click here.
Use at most one supporting icon so the navigation label remains clear.

avoidWhen.when: Submit data or trigger an explicit action.
Show non-interactive prose without a navigation target.
Present an object title together with a supporting identifier.
